Perfect! 🚗 Your 4-wheeler robot is ready! Here's what I created:

## 🤖 Four-Wheeler Robot Features:

**Design:**
- Blue rectangular chassis with a raised "cabin" section
- 4 independently motorized black wheels (cylinder geometry)
- Freejoint for full 6DOF mobility on the ground
- Total mass: ~7 kg (stable for realistic physics)

**Physics:**
- High wheel friction (1.5) for good traction
- Velocity actuators on all 4 wheels (control range: -10 to 10 rad/s)
- Sensors for chassis position and velocity tracking

**Autonomous Driving:**
The robot automatically drives in a pattern:
- **Straight segments** - all wheels at full speed
- **Left turns** - right wheels faster than left
- **Right turns** - left wheels faster than right
- Pattern repeats every 12 seconds

**Controls (data.ctrl):**
- `ctrl[0]` = front-left wheel speed
- `ctrl[1]` = front-right wheel speed
- `ctrl[2]` = rear-left wheel speed
- `ctrl[3]` = rear-right wheel speed

Select **"four_wheeler.xml"** from the scene dropdown and watch it drive! The robot will automatically navigate around. You can also manually control the wheels using the control sliders if you want to drive it yourself.

Want me to add steering, a camera mount, or different driving behaviors (figure-8, obstacle avoidance, etc.)? 🏎️
